lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The high-luminance circular blobs are arranged in approximately 5-6 discernible vertical columns on the mid-flank. Each column contains 3-5 distinct nodes with relatively uniform vertical spacing, decreasing slightly in intensity and size towards the ventral area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a grid-like configuration, most prominent in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. The primary ridge shows a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side and a deep shadow on the ventral side, extending from behind the gills toward the caudal region.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the branchial slits exhibits a transition to a significantly higher density of much smaller, tightly packed punctate marks compared to the larger maculations on the lateral flank.
